## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Riveo's dark editor: video preview on top with a "Double tap to edit" overlay, transport controls, and a timeline with a purple text clip. A tooltip reads "Move the handles to change in and out times". A simulated hand cursor fades in over the clip's edge handle, presses, and drags the handle along the track, the clip resizing with it.

## Motion spec
Pattern: guided gesture demo loop, ~4s per pass.
- The hand cursor fades in over the clip's end handle (300ms) and presses (slight scale down to 0.9, 150ms).
- The hand drags the handle left along the track (1s, ease-in-out); the clip's edge follows 1:1, the clip shrinking, and the playhead time readout updates.
- The hand releases (scale back to 1, 150ms) and fades out (300ms); the clip stays at its new length.
- The sequence loops: the clip restores and the demo replays while the tooltip remains up.

## Calibration
- The hand is a clearly synthetic pointer (soft drop shadow, no skin texture) - a demo affordance, not a real touch.
- The drag speed is deliberate and constant - slow enough to follow.

## Reduced motion
The clip length changes in a single fade between two states.

## Don't miss
- Only the handle under the hand moves; the clip's other edge stays pinned.
- The tooltip text stays visible for the whole demo.
